subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the workflow/security owners accept these 14 upstream GitHub Action revisions for workflows that handle app keys, publishing credentials, attestations, CodeQL uploads, and Codex API secrets?
rationale: The branch makes no local logic or permission change, but it deliberately changes third-party executable code at security-sensitive workflow boundaries; that acceptance is an owner decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept after exact-head checks
options.body: Retain the SHA-pinned Dependabot updates after the branch is refreshed and all required workflow checks complete successfully.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, publishing, attestation, and Codex-action updates from lower-risk maintenance if owners want narrower release-by-release review.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Hold this grouped update if any upstream release requires a workflow-specific compatibility or security review first.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Retain the SHA-pinned Dependabot updates after the branch is refreshed and all required workflow checks complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely central decision point for repository-wide workflow and security-boundary changes; confidence is limited without a completed local feature-history read.
